name: Keap
description: Keap provides CRM, sales automation, marketing, appointments, invoicing, payments, and commerce workflows.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Keap Personal Access Token, then let agents list only bounded projected contact custom-field metadata under approval. Relay excludes options, defaults, groups, optional properties, values, CRM and commerce records, writes, administration, bulk operations, and raw API access.

credentialRequirements.name: KEAP_ACCESS_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Keap access token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Store a dedicated least-privilege Personal Access Token only through Relay's encrypted flow.

capabilities.label: List contact custom-field metadata
capabilities.description: List at most 100 field IDs, labels, record types, field types, and field names without options, defaults, groups, optional properties, values, or CRM records.

approvalRequired.label: List contact custom-field metadata
approvalRequired.description: List bounded projected contact custom-field definitions from Keap.

blocked.label: Access CRM or commerce records
blocked.description: Contacts, companies, opportunities, notes, tasks, appointments, files, emails, campaigns, tags, orders, subscriptions, transactions, payment methods, affiliates, and users are blocked.

blocked.label: Access private schema logic
blocked.description: Field options, default values, groups, group names, optional properties, field values, and full model responses are blocked.

blocked.label: Mutate or administer Keap
blocked.description: Creates, updates, deletes, email sends, campaign enrollment, tagging, imports, exports, schema changes, payments, and settings changes are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw or bulk API access
blocked.description: Arbitrary paths, filters, searches, raw responses, legacy XML-RPC, later pages, redirects, retries, and bulk access are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded field-metadata read requires approval; CRM/commerce records, private schema logic, writes, administration, bulk, and raw APIs remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded metadata read runs without Relay per-action approval; fixed origin/path binding, projection, caps, audits, and no-write behavior remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway binds a customer-owned token to Keap's fixed API origin and projected contact-model wrapper.
Railway binds a customer-owned token to Keap's fixed API origin and projected contact-model wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: An authorized Keap user must provision a dedicated least-privilege Personal Access Token and store it through Relay. No account, OAuth app, token, credential capture, consent, live request, or provider acceptance is available in this worker task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized user provisions the least-privilege token, stores it through Relay, then verifies health, one approved metadata list, throttling, token rotation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Keap documents GET /crm/rest/v2/contacts/model with custom field metadata and optional properties. Relay projects only field identity/type metadata and excludes options, defaults, groups, optional properties, values, records, and writes.

Keap documents Personal Access Tokens used as Bearer credentials under the creating user's visibility and editing permissions. Relay requires a dedicated least-privilege customer-owned token and never provisions or captures it in this worker task.
